nodes.label: code-improver Agent
nodes.rationale: Strictly read-only reviewer (tools: Read, Glob, Grep; model sonnet; memory project) reporting improvements across readability, performance, and best practices. It must respect existing codebase idioms rather than imposing its own, prioritize by impact over nitpicks, and say so honestly when a file is already well written instead of inventing issues.

edges.source_location: Respect the conventions and idioms already present in the codebase
